newsitem.title: DUBAI: New Islamic bank set up in Bahrain.
newsitem.headline: New Islamic bank set up in Bahrain.

text.p: A new Islamic bank has been set up in Bahrain, its chief executive Majid al-Refai was quoted as saying on Wednesday in United Arab Emirates newspapers.

The newspapers said the First Islamic Investment Bank -- formed by the Saudi Al Jomaih Group and the Cayman Islands registered, Kuwaiti-owned Majestic Global Investments -- received its licence to operate this week.
The bank has authorised capital of $50 million, papers said.
Islamic banks do not deal in interest -- the core of the Western banking system -- as it is regarded by many Moslems as usury, which is banned under Islamic sharia law.
